QUESTION:
What is the default value of `partitioner.max_connections`?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0859] config | replicator.max_connections | version 4.x
# `replicator.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `4096` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | connections |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `replicator.max_connections` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
max_connections = 4096
```

---

[d0878] config | replicator.max_connections (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `replicator.max_connections` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1024` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | connections |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
max_connections = 1024
```

---

[d0596] config | partitioner.max_retries (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `partitioner.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 10
```
